author: Mr_Vercius
body:
At your tier, I was constantly running overworld bosses with lucky silver and gold coins, exp potion, and dowsing rods, along with the overworld shrines you can pick up for +100% exp. Sometimes some bosses can drop 100mil+ exp if you're lucky on a berserk boss.

You get skeleton keys and summoning scrolls by doing content, think dungeons, monuments, overworld activities, etc.

You will not see a tower until you hit tier 9.

Kingdoms usually have raids you can do damage on, the higher level the kingdom the higher the level raids that are unlocked.

Best advice i can give you is to keep grinding, hitting all the bosses you can, all the berserk enemies you can, run occult candle and affinity candle, plus the shrines, exp potions, and coins. Save up all your orns, and when you get to towers, save your shards for a celestial class.

Edit: Also, level up your highest tier gear to level 10. Helps with assigning othersouls gear later for settlements.

author: Seniori_Gamer
body: Im also pretty much new at the game (been playing for a little over 2 weeks), and best advice I can give you as I've reached lvl 220 during my time is to rush T8 and get cursed monster tomes from Fafnir as ornate tier tome gives +56% EXP bonus. Get Super EXP potion from guilds (each guild gives atleast one super exp potion and you'd have to grind a bit but they're so worth it for the threefold exp boost). Stack all EXP boost equipment, potions, and shrines, and a Berserk Heimdall (T8 boss) gives about 400M EXP.

author: Kydd
body:
Hey, it looks like like myself, you opted for the path of Nyx/Realmshifter. 

Change your class ASAP! I recommend Beowolf/Bestla or Summoner. The issue at the higher tiers is survivability, the Realmshifter is so incredibly gear and ascension levels dependent that it is for later endgame stages. (Ascension levels are endgame, from the altar of ascension that costs 50M orns, I'd buy all the other classes before investing in this.)

The summoner and Beowolf classes will allow you to focus on your defenses while allowing your pets/summons to clear. If you go summoner  and get Buganne summon, I believe last chance is today. Try and also get Arisen Spirit Garm pet, it's t10, you can buy it in the shop if needed, it hits like a truck, mine crits for over 5Million at the moment.

You will very soon loose the ability to 1 tap everything and it will likely be weeks until you get it back t10.

Complete the main story quest ASAP, you really want the Band of God's accessory, which also puts it in your lootable pool of items at the end of dungeons.

Other than that just keep grinding with boosts active until you reach t10, then have fun running into that brick wall.
